subject: Made 2 apps, put on EC2, one works one fails

messages.author: 9febcbf26d2ccc5b
messages.subject: Made 2 apps, put on EC2, one works one fails
parts:
Hello,
I have the same "The application has failed to start" as a previous user in this forum;

An error has occurred

The application failed to start.

The application exited during initialization.

Error in source(serverR, local = new.env(parent = .GlobalEnv)) : 4:1: unexpected '<' 3: 4: < ^ Calls: runApp ... eval.parent -> eval -> eval -> eval -> eval -> source Execution halted I

I installed Shiny on Amazon EC2 using this tutorial's instructions.  I built two apps that both work fine locally.  I put them on my EC2 instance, and one works, while the other one throws this error.  I also got the Shiny examples working as well.  So I'm not sure what this issue is with this app, especially since it works locally.


Thanks.
